firstPlayerRule: The player with the freshest breath starts.
clarifications: That player takes the Starting Player token; all players receive an equal number of turns.

This finished sheet supersedes the archived booklet with unfinished placeholders and matches inventory BGG 230251. SHA-256: d638e1d8dc84653cfc6edefe8b1fea7b095f282d3b0442558d3d4c38fa72a542. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the opening instruction, game identity and named edition against the rendered rulebook.
uncertainty: The rules give no objective test or tie procedure for freshest breath.

fairUse.rationale: Small clean photograph of the original product tin identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article. It is used for editorial reference with no more package artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: The Game Steward listing https://www.thegamesteward.com/products/mint-delivery identifies its photographed tin as the Five24 Labs Mint Delivery Kickstarter edition and lists the original components. The creator-led 2017 campaign https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/poketto/mint-delivery-the-minty-fresh-pick-up-and-deliver independently identifies the original game as a pocket-sized mint tin. The Five24 Labs English rules sheet dated 2017 identifies the same game and publisher. The photographed tin is the original package; the retailer image does not establish publisher permission or that every Kickstarter extra is covered by the cited rules sheet. Reduced to 360 pixels wide.
